source.idea: Wire Matrix Designer (the LangGraph multi-agent brain) into Matrix Builder end-to-end: the Blueprint Details page renders REAL agent output (top-3 blueprints + overview, architecture, batches, file plan, Matrix rules) and the Talk-to-blueprint chat calls the orchestrator to refine the design, governed by Matrix Definitions and watsonx-only, native to GitPilot.

goal_analysis.real_goal: Replace the Details page's client-side derivation with the real multi-agent designer, opt-in behind the Matrix Designer toggle, fail-closed and watsonx-only, with zero regression when the toggle is off.
goal_analysis.audience: Enterprises adopting governed, AI-designed software at scale.
missing_decisions: transport: MCP stdio vs HTTP proxy in services/api
where design bundles persist (build version vs separate table)
guest/offline behaviour when the brain is unavailable

risks.risk: Designer output diverges from the Details page data model.
risks.mitigation: Share one schema: blueprint-details mirrors the TS interfaces; contract test both sides.

risks.risk: A slow/failing LLM blocks the UI.
risks.mitigation: Deterministic runner fallback + timeout; toggle-off keeps today's behaviour.
watsonx-only enforced by env + a CTL/DESIGN rule in matrix-definitions.

framework_decision.rationale: Reuse the existing stacks: LangGraph for the brain, FastAPI for the matrix-builder control plane, Next.js/TS for apps/web. No new runtime.

rejected.why_not: Couples design logic to the UI; loses the reusable MCP server and CLI.

rejected.option: Call the LLM directly from the browser
rejected.why_not: Breaks watsonx-only governance and leaks keys.

visual_target.style: Unchanged — the premium dark Details page already shipped; this fills it with real data.
must_include: Design Brain section when the toggle is on
must_avoid: any regression when Matrix Designer is off
blocking the UI on the LLM

architecture.diagram: apps/web -> services/api -> matrix-designer (MCP/HTTP) -> LangGraph brain -> BlueprintDetails -> apps/web

data_model: BlueprintCandidate { id, tier, title, summary, file_count, difficulty, estimate, stack, recommended }
BlueprintDetails { candidate_id, overview, architecture[], batches[], file_plan[], matrix_rules[], acceptance, validation, risks, assumptions, design_brain, chat_history[] }

functional: with the Matrix Designer toggle ON, the Details page renders real agent output for all 3 blueprints
Talk-to-blueprint chat calls refine_design and shows the updated batches
with the toggle OFF, behaviour is byte-for-byte today's deterministic derivation (no regression)
all LLM usage is watsonx-only; offline falls back to the deterministic runner
matrix-builder typecheck + build clean; matrix-designer tests green
visual: Design Brain section appears only when the toggle is on
performance: candidates return < 4s or fall back to deterministic with a notice
accessibility: chat composer keeps aria-labels; no blocking spinners without a timeout

batch_roadmap.name: Design brain & shared contract
batch_roadmap.purpose: Land design-bundle + blueprint-details schemas in matrix-builder contracts and register them; one schema both sides validate.
new_features: design-bundle + blueprint-details schemas registered, owned_by += matrix-designer
acceptance: schemas validate the matrix-designer example bundle
schema-registry lists both

batch_roadmap.name: Designer service (HTTP/MCP)
batch_roadmap.purpose: Expose generate_blueprints + refine_design over an HTTP endpoint (FastAPI) in matrix-designer, alongside the existing stdio MCP server.
acceptance: service returns 3 blueprints for a sample idea
watsonx-only honoured; deterministic fallback when no key

batch_roadmap.name: Control-plane proxy endpoints
batch_roadmap.purpose: Add the 4 blueprint endpoints to matrix-builder services/api, proxying the designer service (or importing matrix_designer).
acceptance: endpoints return schema-valid payloads
designer unavailable -> deterministic fallback, never 500

batch_roadmap.name: Typed web client
batch_roadmap.purpose: Add blueprint methods to apps/web workflow-client with auth headers + a deterministic offline fallback.
acceptance: client typechecks
falls back to local derivation when offline or toggle off

batch_roadmap.name: Wire candidates to the brain
batch_roadmap.purpose: When the Matrix Designer toggle is ON, source the 3 cards from the designer; OFF keeps today's deterministic candidates.
acceptance: toggle ON -> agent candidates; OFF -> unchanged
no regression in the choose flow

batch_roadmap.name: Details page from real BlueprintDetails
batch_roadmap.purpose: Replace the client-side deriveBatches/deriveArchitecture/deriveFilePlan with fetched BlueprintDetails when available.
acceptance: Details renders real agent data
deterministic derivation remains the offline fallback

batch_roadmap.name: Live Talk-to-blueprint
batch_roadmap.purpose: Wire the chat composer + Save to refine_design / save endpoints; unsaved-edits badge.
acceptance: ‘add a boss level’ adds a batch in the UI
Save persists; contract only changes on save

batch_roadmap.name: Design Brain panel
batch_roadmap.purpose: Populate the Design Brain section from the designer’s reasoning (intent, dependency graph, visual acceptance).
new_features: Design Brain shows product intent + batch dependency graph
acceptance: panel shows only when the toggle is on
content comes from the bundle, not hard-coded

batch_roadmap.name: Matrix Definitions design rules
batch_roadmap.purpose: Add DESIGN-*/GAME-* rules + a web-game design-pack so design bundles are validated by the signed authority.
new_features: DESIGN-001..004 + GAME-001..010 promoted to a signed pack
acceptance: validator rejects an unscoped batch
game bundle without visual acceptance is needs-repair

batch_roadmap.name: watsonx-only governance
batch_roadmap.purpose: Enforce approved-provider-only across the designer + builder; add a control rule and env gate.
acceptance: non-watsonx provider is refused
no keys committed

batch_roadmap.name: Persist design bundles
batch_roadmap.purpose: Store the chosen design bundle + chat history with the build so it survives reload and syncs across devices.
new_features: design_bundles table linked to a version
acceptance: reopen a build -> same blueprint + chat
RLS keeps it owner-scoped

batch_roadmap.name: End-to-end proof: Contract Quest
batch_roadmap.purpose: Run idea -> designer -> builder -> GitPilot for the Contract Quest game and confirm a playable result.
new_features: scripted E2E: design bundle -> mb next sequence -> validated batches
acceptance: E2E produces an mb-next sequence that matches the roadmap
Contract Quest builds from the generated plan

batch_roadmap.name: Docs, screenshots & release
batch_roadmap.purpose: Document the integration, capture before/after screenshots, version bump, changelog.
acceptance: docs build
changelog updated
screenshots show real agent data in the Details page
